page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.xlarge is a compute-focused x86_64 instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, offering 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores with Hyper-Threading active. The CPU architecture includes 35 MB of L3 cache and supports instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AES-NI, and FMA. The instance is paired with 4.0 GB of RAM, yielding 1.0 GB of memory per vCPU core. It has no local NVMe or SSD storage and includes 0 GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage while providing 2 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations place the processing and memory subsystems of this instance in lower performance tiers across standard workloads. Single-core CPU testing via stress-ng yields 1102.69, while multi-core performance reaches 2935.19. Synthetic CPU scores include a Geekbench single-core result of 984.0 and a multi-core result of 2207.0. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 20.87 GB/sec and write bandwidth measures 18.81 GB/sec, reflecting a lower-capacity memory bus configuration.

Application testing demonstrates a throughput of 2.88 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks and 3.47 GB/sec for static web serving. For lightweight AI tasks, prompt processing speed reaches 239.2 tokens per second on a small 135M parameter language model, though larger models are unsupported due to the 4.0 GB memory limitation. The hardware trade-off balances a low memory footprint against dedicated thread allocation.

The ecs.ic5.xlarge instance is suitable for lightweight CPU-bound tasks, basic web serving, low-traffic microservices, and small batch processing applications that do not require high memory capacity or local disk storage.
